items.source: Return any exception raised by a handler and successfully resolved through a HandlerExceptionResolver.
items.translation: 返回由处理器引发并通过 `HandlerExceptionResolver` 成功解析的任何异常。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the async result was not set
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果异步结果未设置

items.source: This method will wait for the async result to be set within the timeout value associated with the async request, see MockAsyncContext#setTimeout. Alternatively, use getAsyncResult(long) to specify the amount of time to wait.
items.translation: 此方法将等待异步结果在与此异步请求关联的超时值内设置，请参阅 MockAsyncContext#setTimeout。或者，使用 getAsyncResult(long) 指定等待的时间量。

items.source: Return the ModelAndView prepared by the handler.
Get the result of async execution and wait if necessary.
items.translation: 获取异步执行的结果，并在必要时等待。

items.source: Return the "output" flash attributes saved during request processing.
items.translation: 返回请求处理期间保存的"output"flash 属性。

items.source: Return the executed handler.
Return interceptors around the handler.
items.translation: 在处理器周围返回拦截器。

items.source: Return the performed request.
Return the resulting response.

timeToWait - how long to wait for the async result to be set, in milliseconds; if -1, then fall back on the timeout value associated with the async request, see MockAsyncContext#setTimeout for more details.
items.translation: timeToWait - 等待异步结果设置的时长，单位为毫秒；如果为 -1，则回退到与异步请求关联的超时值，有关详细信息请参阅 MockAsyncContext#setTimeout。

items.source: a ModelAndView, or null if none
the request (never null)
the response (never null)
the handler, possibly null if none were executed
items.translation: 处理器，如果未执行任何操作则可能为null

items.source: interceptors, or null if none were selected
items.translation: 拦截器，或者如果未选择任何拦截器则为null

items.source: an exception, or null if none
the FlashMap, possibly empty
Provides access to the result of an executed request.
items.translation: 提供已执行请求结果的访问权限。

items.source: Get the result of async execution.
